description: Form settings. A LIMIT ON HOW MANY RECORDS A FORM TAKES is turn_off_form_after — «close registration at 300 people» is this, and nothing else: never hide the add button or the page for it (that closes the form NOW). The answer says how many records the form holds and whether it is open. Update a form's settings: post_action (redirect URL after submit), per_page, sort_by, allow_delete, send_emails, inline_editing, allow_database, lqe_use_only_login and others.

confirmation_checkbox.description: A consent checkbox at the bottom of the form that must be ticked before the form can be sent (the field picker's «Confirmation checkbox»): true adds it, false removes it. One per form; it is a setting of the form, not a field

confirmation_checkbox_text.description: The sentence beside the consent checkbox, e.g. «I agree to my data being stored». Required when the checkbox is added; given alone, it adds the checkbox

dtype_added_text.description: Text after a successful form submit

per_page.description: Number of records per page (max 100, default 20)

post_action.description: URL to redirect to after the form is submitted

redirect_to_new_page.description: Open target_page in a new tab instead of in the current one

send_emails.description: Send an email notification on a new record

target_page.description: Where to send the person AFTER the PUBLIC form (the widget) is submitted. A full URL. Does not affect records created internally by staff.

turn_off_form.description: false removes the limit on the number of records (the form takes records again). true is only needed to switch back on a limit set before.

turn_off_form_after.description: Close the form at this many records: «close registration at 300 people», «only 50 places», «stop taking orders after 100». The form stays OPEN until the table holds that many — it is not closed now. Given alone, it switches the limit on.

turn_off_form_msg_text.description: What people see instead of the form once it is closed by the limit below

name: update_form_settings
